title: Petition of AAA Airporter Services, Inc. requesting that the Department issue it a certificate of public convenience and necessity over a specified routes in Boston, Waltham, Newton, Dedham, Needham, Lexington, Weston, Wellesley, Westwood, and under the jurisdiction of the Massachusetts Turnpike Authority, pursuant to the provisions of G.L. c. 159A, § 7, and issue it a charter license from a garaging point in Westwood, Massachusetts, pursuant to the provisions of G.L. c. 159A, § 11A.
